pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches characterized by high-frequency serrated edge gradients. Geometries on the flank are larger and more contiguous, while those on the lower neck exhibit smaller, more fragmented spatial areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space with clearly defined junction nodes (predominantly tri-valent). Pathway thickness remains relatively uniform throughout the visible flank region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency brush-like silhouette against the background, extending from the mid-neck to the shoulder ridge.
